text_block_list.text: The day of the Kyodo News Hai.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
All right, do your best, C.B....!
First win this one, and next is the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Young Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Right! Let's build up some momentum for the Classic campaign! Good luck, C.B.!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
......
...People are talking about it after all. Heheh!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Right? She's amazing!
I want to race against her soon too...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"‘Satsuki Sho’... and then the ‘Japanese Derby’,
and after that the ‘Kikuka Sho’! Ah, I can't wait!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Show 'em what you've got, C.B.!
Give it your all!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
—What a great atmosphere.
Hot, electric, and full of exhilaration.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Now...! Let's see what kind of race
I should run today!
